reference_format.note: YY/NNNNN/TYPE. References carry NO council prefix, so the type suffix is the only scope signal.

quirks.summary: Search-result metaInfo fields are separated by U+00B7, not '|', so a parser splitting on '|' swallows the whole block and every reference arrives with its metadata attached.
quirks.detail: A reference comes back as '26/01680/DOC · Received: … · Validated: …' rather than '26/01680/DOC'. That silently defeats suffix-based scoping — condition discharges pass straight through a filter keyed on the suffix. The same bug was observed at Horsham.
quirks.workaround: Split on U+00B7 (or take the reference up to the first separator) and confirm the suffix filter actually excludes something before trusting a cohort.

quirks.summary: HTTP 429 at 6 s spacing after about a dozen requests, on two separate days; 10 s spacing was clean.
quirks.detail: The earlier finding was 429 at 3 s and stable at 6 s. Repeated paced retrievals in September 2026 tripped the limit at 6 s too, after roughly twelve requests. At 10 s a run of 48 requests and then more completed without a 429.
quirks.workaround: Pace at 10 s. Stop on the first run of 429s rather than retrying.

quirks.summary: An advanced search by proposal text returned a genuine-looking 'No results found' page; the same search on a fresh session returned results.
quirks.workaround: Retry once on a fresh cookie jar and _csrf, and run a date-only control search, before recording that nothing matched.

quirks.summary: Committee reports are published as RTF, not PDF.
quirks.detail: A retrieval that extracts text only from PDFs records the committee report as unreadable or empty, so an application that went to committee looks as though it has no usable report.
quirks.workaround: Check magic bytes ({\rtf) and extract text from RTF as well as PDF.

quirks.summary: Each discharge-of-condition documents tab carries a 'copy of original decision notice', which is the parent permission's decision, not the discharge's.
quirks.detail: A classifier that labels documents from their description will take it for that application's own decision notice, so the discharge appears decided on the parent's date and terms.
quirks.workaround: Treat a description containing 'copy of original decision' as parent material, and take the discharge's own decision from its own decision-notice row.

pacing.note: 429s at 3 s, and at 6 s after about a dozen requests on two separate days in September 2026; 10 s was clean across 48 and more requests.

source_notes:
The only Sussex Idox install so far on the STANDARD document route (Recipe C): it has a real `documents` tab, where Mid Sussex, Horsham, Lewes and Adur & Worthing all use `externalDocuments` pointing at a separate store. Verified end to end 22 Aug 2026: documents tab -> /online-applications/files/{32-HEX}/pdf/{name} -> real PDF (%PDF-), Referer set to the documents-tab URL. RATE LIMIT: 429s at 3s spacing (as Horsham); 6s is stable. REFERENCES CARRY NO COUNCIL PREFIX - the form is YY/NNNNN/TYPE and the TYPE suffix is the only scope signal, so cohort rules must key on the suffix, not a prefix. SAME METADATA-SEPARATOR BUG AS HORSHAM: result metaInfo is separated by U+00B7 '.' not '|', so a parser using [^|]+ swallows the whole block and every reference arrives as '26/01680/DOC . Received: ... . Validated: ...'. That silently defeats suffix-based scoping - condition discharges pass straight through.

SCOPE TRAP: the ADJ suffix is 'adjoining authority consultation' - applications DECIDED BY ANOTHER AUTHORITY (South Downs NPA, Arun, East Hampshire, Havant) on which Chichester is only a consultee. Eight sat in a first-pass major-housing cohort; left in they attribute other councils' decisions to Chichester. Also exclude PREMP/PRESMP (pre-application enquiries), HRA (reg 77 assessments), DOM, ELD/PLD. Keep OBG (s106 obligation discharge) for triage - it is a commitment-change vehicle. Scope caveat: much of the district is in the South Downs National Park where SDNPA is the LPA, so the district's major-housing set is genuinely reduced.

verification.note: Verified end to end: documents tab -> /online-applications/files/{32-HEX}/pdf/{name} -> real PDF (%PDF- magic bytes), with Referer set to the documents-tab URL. The only Sussex Idox install tested so far on the standard Recipe C document route.
Landing-page survey 2026-09-16: HTTP 200; vendor confirmed by fingerprint (idox-public-access)
End-to-end: advanced search over 1-31 July 2026 -> first result -> documents tab (6 file links) -> downloaded one file, 65536 bytes, magic bytes 255044462d312e34 = pdf.

Recorded from repeated paced retrievals in September 2026 (reported in issue #67), not re-run for this change: 429 at 6 s spacing on two days, 10 s clean; committee reports served as RTF; discharge-of-condition tabs carry a copy of the parent decision notice. An advanced search by proposal text for a parent reference once returned a false 'no results' page; the same search on a fresh session returned results.
